{"code":"import random

def vary(example, rng):
    h = rng.randint(2, 6)
    w = rng.randint(2, 6)
    # The only observed colours are the three stripe colours; use these palette
    # colours while changing band count/order and dimensions.
    palette = [6, 8, 9]
    colors = [rng.choice(palette) for _ in range(w)]
    if len(set(colors)) == 1:
        colors[rng.randrange(w)] = rng.choice([c for c in palette if c != colors[0]])
